events.title: Build a Ruthless AI Researcher Workshop
events.description: A practical technical session focused on leveraging AI tools to accelerate research and data analysis processes. Expect a hands-on environment aimed at those looking to integrate automation into their intellectual workflows.

events.title: Intro to Claude Workshop
events.description: An introductory session on using Claude AI for productivity and creative brainstorming. Attendees will explore prompting techniques and use-cases in an interactive group setting.

events.title: Brisbane Sculpture Festival
events.description: An exhibition showcasing contemporary sculptural works by local artists set within the Botanic Gardens. A great opportunity to explore creative expression and design in an outdoor environment.

events.title: LUMINOUS Lantern Parade
events.description: A community-led lantern parade celebrating diversity and artistic expression. It features light-based installations and performances, fostering a collective, atmospheric experience in the heart of the city.
